name: B/1 Work Visa

qualifying_event.description: An Israeli employer sponsors a foreign worker (commonly a 'foreign expert' filling a role requiring skills unavailable locally) and obtains a work permit, on the basis of which the worker applies for a B/1 visa.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Employer sponsorship; work permit obtained by the employer from Israeli authorities.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer sponsorship, with the employer obtaining a work permit on the worker's behalf.
Role typically requires specialized expertise not readily available in the local labour market ('foreign expert' basis).

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed precisely in this pass; commonly renewed annually

sources.title: Rivermate (Employer-of-Record relocation guide) -- Israel B/1 work visa: employer-obtained work permit precedes the visa application; commonly used for 'foreign expert' roles requiring specialized skills
